reviews.text: I'm so happy! I've only had my puppy for a few weeks and she's already been with Cristina twice. She's so happy and enjoys it. She loves going with her! And Cristina treats her so well and even plays with her if I have to leave her for a little while longer. THANK YOU
I take my dog ​​there every month to get her bathed and her hair cut, and I couldn't be happier with them. They treat her and take great care of her. Cristina is a true professional.

A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE... I absolutely do not recommend this place. They change their prices whenever they want, and on top of that, their prices are exorbitant. They answer you with arrogance, very rudeness, and a lack of respect. I went to make an appointment and the girl told me the price was between €27 and €30 just for washing. I've always paid €25 and have been taking my car there since they opened. She told me the prices had gone up because the place had changed owners. I accepted and made the reservation. I had to wait four days. The day I took my car there, the woman who used to be the employee and is now the owner was there. She rudely told me the price had gone up to €33. I politely explained that the day I went to make the appointment, the girl had given me a different price, and she started arguing with me like a madwoman, telling me she was now the owner, contradicting me, and accusing me of haggling. She was incredibly rude and disrespectful. She even started looking for my file, as if I were lying to her. She saw that I always paid €25 and that I wasn't lying or haggling; I was just trying to explain what I thought was wrong. The problem is that when I went to make an appointment, they told me one price, and now she's telling me another, but she keeps accusing me of haggling and rudely telling me that she's now the owner. I don't know who she thinks she is, but she's definitely rude and very unprofessional. If she treats animals with the same arrogance, it's no wonder several people in the neighborhood don't want to take them there anymore. I only took my dog ​​there occasionally because he'd had cuts on his stomach and anus several times, and several people have told me the same thing. It's absolutely unacceptable that she answers you like that and then accuses me of haggling as if I were at the grocery store. I hope the people in the neighborhood realize what kind of person she is because if she treats customers like that, she's not going to do very well.
Kind and caring with my dog ​​Mina, she always leaves happy and with a good haircut.

I've been taking my dog ​​there since he was a puppy, and they always make him look gorgeous. Cristina is not only a fantastic professional but also lovely 😊. The best groomer, without a doubt. Thanks, Cris!!

I went to make an appointment and they gave me one price, but when I took my dog ​​in, they changed the price and spoke to me terribly. A really nice girl used to run the place, but now her former employee is in charge. She says she's raised the prices, even though they were already quite expensive. On top of that, she's incredibly arrogant; I don't know who she thinks she is. They don't give you a fixed price upfront and raise it as she sees fit.
It's extremely expensive, and they don't even do a very good job. They also use industrial shampoos that are terrible for a dog's skin. The service is definitely not good, and the price is outrageous. I absolutely do not recommend them.
How could I not be happy when I took my two little rascals and they turned out to be lovely ladies? I'll always be back. Thank you so much, girls! (And they love the bones!)

Amazing dog grooming! Cris is super affectionate with the little ones, takes all the time in the world to work at their pace, and they look gorgeous! The atmosphere is so peaceful as soon as you walk in :) Highly, highly recommended!

I couldn't be happier that I found this groomer for my dog. From day one, they've treated her with incredible care and always welcome her like family. She leaves looking gorgeous, but what I love most is seeing her calm and happy after every visit. You can tell they do their job with so much love and dedication. Thank you for taking such good care of her; it's so reassuring to leave her in your hands. I recommend them without hesitation!

I can only say that our experience was wonderful. It was the first time we took our dog (over 60kg) to a dog groomer because he's quite timid, and to our surprise, he loved it. The groomer treated him with great care, and we were very satisfied. 🙂 We'll definitely be back! …
Fantastic work! We took our dog Bimba, and both she and we were delighted. 😀 Cris is lovely and incredibly professional. I highly recommend her.

There are places where they don't just bathe and groom our furry friends... they make them feel like royalty! ❤️🐶

From day one, Cris achieved something that seemed impossible: my dog ​​not only overcame her fear of baths, but she also goes absolutely wild with joy every time she knows she's going to see her! As soon as she sees her, she wags her tail like she's about to visit her best friend, and that says so much about the person behind the scissors and the dryer.

The service is top-notch. Cris works with endless patience, so much love, tenderness, and enormous respect for each dog. While she bathes them, she speaks to them gently, gives them cuddles and treats, and manages to transform an experience that many dogs find nerve-wracking into a pleasant and fun moment.

She's not just an exceptional dog groomer; she's someone who truly loves what she does, and it shows in every detail. When my little one leaves there, she comes back happy, relaxed, and gorgeous. And for me, there's no better sign that he's in the best hands.

If you're looking for a place where they care for your furry friend like family, look no further. I would recommend it a hundred times over. Because many can give a good haircut, but getting a dog to come in wagging its tail and leave even happier... that's something very few people can do.

A VERY BAD EXPERIENCE with this groomer. We took her for the first time on a recommendation, and they over-shaved her in several areas, including her belly, vulva, and near her anus. Three days later, our dog is still uncomfortable with irritation. For what they did, I consider the price excessive and the grooming unprofessional. This experience has convinced us to buy clippers and do it ourselves. We will not leave our dog at any other groomer. NOT RECOMMENDED.
100000/10 The best in Madrid! Super professional and punctual. I can't recommend them enough!
I take my dog ​​Mia there, we are very happy with the treatment and how well they treat the dogs.

I took Nala, my dog, and I couldn't be happier with the service she received from Cristina. She's an excellent professional and incredibly kind to animals. I highly recommend her, and I will definitely be back. Thank you so much!

We've finally found a dog groomer who really understands the cut of a very poodle-like Maltipoo. Cristina takes all the time necessary to untangle the knots, and the cut is perfect. It's a pleasure to work with such a groomer.
Excellent service and a good price. Very friendly and I'm so happy with how they treated my dog! I highly recommend them!

I love how they groom my Yorkshire Terrier. We adopted her when she was older, and she used to tremble at the sight of a brush. Thanks to Dog Day, she's no longer afraid of being brushed. She goes in happy and comes out happy and gorgeous. They make time for you and let you know if there's a cancellation... They're lovely.
Cris is wonderful with both animals and their owners. A true professional.

Our cocker spaniel had dermatitis and allergies. They took care of him, finding all sorts of products. With so much love. They are super professional and even more affectionate. The best. Here they are, looking fabulous.
I take my little dog, Lúa, a miniature schnauzer, there. I love how they treat her, and they're super caring with the animals.
Fantastic service from Cristina and her team. So professional and such a love for dogs. Thank you!
Cristina is lovely and gave my dog ​​a fantastic haircut. You can tell she really loves dogs; she inspires a lot of confidence in me.

Thank you so much, our Pomeranian Bruno was treated and groomed wonderfully.

We'll gladly come back when we're in Madrid again.

Thanks insta: bruno_rey_7

We have a 9-month-old Maltese who is very anxious and fearful. Since she was 4 months old, when we started taking her to the groomer, we've gone to Día de Perros (Dog Day) and they've always done an amazing job 😍.

What I love most is that they clearly respect the time she needs to relax and treat her wonderfully!

I can only recommend the fantastic work they do 🥰
A very friendly team, I have taken my fox terrier many times for bathing and haircuts and they do a great job.
I highly recommend it! My dog ​​always looks super cute.
Bico always leaves happy, they treat him very well and always make him look great.
Excellent service for the price. We always take our dog there.
Thank you very much for your review, Juan Carlos. Best regards.

Wonderful Cris and Maria, thank you! Today we took our miniature schnauzer, Ely, for the first time. She's 7 months old and has very long, light-colored, knotty hair. They made her look beautiful, and she seemed very happy. I highly recommend this groomer; I'll always take her there.

Amazing service! They were incredibly kind to my dog ​​Gus, even though he still gets very restless when they strip him.
I'll definitely be back; they made him look fantastic!
